input.brief: Pushkar Verma, high-end video editor and motion designer. Neobrutalism minimal style, original ratio video carousel, modern video editing UI components

direction.name: The name as a monument
direction.idea: The name is the headline. Set it so large that it becomes architecture: as wide as the viewport, cropped by an edge, or stacked to fill the screen. Nothing else on the first screen competes; the description of what this is drops to a single small sentence. The idea comes from treating the name's letters as material. Ask what the subject can do to its own name: a photograph of the work sits inside a counter or replaces a letter, the name repeats down the page like a reel, the letters are split to opposite corners and the page happens between them. In the study this was the single most common device among sites scoring 7.5 or more.
direction.composition: First screen: the wordmark spans 88–100% of the viewport width (font-size 16–24vw, set with a clamp so it never wraps), anchored either to the bottom edge with its descenders nearly touching it, or dead centre with everything else pushed to the corners. One line of supporting text at 16–20px sits in a corner on a shared margin; navigation is three or four words in the opposite corner. After the hero the page is deliberately small and calm: a narrow text column or a simple two-column grid, so the contrast with the monument holds. The name returns once more at full width as the footer, in the inverse colours. Margins are tight (20–32px) so the type reaches the edges. Two type sizes do nearly all the work: the monument and a small text size, with one mid size for section headings.
direction.typography: One family. The display cut must survive enormous sizes: tight tracking (-0.04 to -0.07em), leading 0.8–0.9, optical kerning on. Section headings are modest (28–40px) on purpose.
direction.colour: Two values carry the page (ground and ink). The accent, if used at all, appears on one thing only: the single action or the inset image frame. The footer inverts ground and ink.
direction.imagery: Few images, used as inserts in the typography rather than as illustrations beside it: one photograph inside or behind the name (a 4:5 or 1:1 frame replacing a letter, or tucked between two words), then a short run of large full-width or half-width photographs further down. Square corners. No collage of small thumbnails.
direction.richness: Scale. The size of the name against the smallness of everything else is the entire visual event, so protect both ends: do not shrink the name to make room, and do not let body text creep above 20px.
direction.pitfalls: A long name set small is just a logo. If the name has more than about 12 characters, stack it on two lines or crop it with the viewport edge; never drop below 12vw. Do not add a second big headline under the name. Do not decorate the letters.

hero.name: Film title, bottom edge
hero.blueprint: One photograph fills the viewport at 100vw by 100svh, `object-fit: cover`, with its subject in the upper two-thirds and a calmer, darker zone along the bottom. The name is one condensed uppercase word, or a short name in a high-contrast serif, set at clamp(150px, 17.5vw, 290px) and sized to span the full width between 32px margins. It is centred and anchored so its baseline sits 34px above the bottom edge, covering roughly the lowest quarter of the frame. A soft neutral dark scrim lies under that bottom band only, about 40% of the height; the rest of the image is untouched. Directly above the name's left end, on the same margin, sits the supporting sentence at 16px on two short lines. Directly above its right end, right-aligned, sits the single action as a small paper-coloured rectangular button. The top edge carries a small emblem or wordmark at the left margin and up to five text links at 15px grouped at the right, all in white. The central half of the screen belongs to the view.
hero.mobile: The photograph is re-cropped to portrait with `object-position` on its subject and fills 100svh. The name stays on the bottom edge at 22vw on one line, or two lines at 20vw beyond eight characters, 20px above the edge. The supporting sentence sits above the name's left end at 15px. The action button moves to the top-right corner and the links collapse to a menu word beside the emblem.
hero.headline: The name of the place: one word of up to about 12 characters at 17.5vw, or two words stacked on a phone.

type.note: A heavy sans with tight joins and an eccentric lowercase, friendly but loud. Suits bookshops, food, consumer subscriptions and marketing studios.

palette.name: Graphite and orange
palette.note: Graphite and cool light-grey sections alternate, graphite taking about two thirds, and photographs are desaturated so nothing competes. Safety orange marks the buttons, one thick solid bar across the top of the page and the highlighted item in a list or chart.

photos.note: misty, muted, minimal landscapes and empty horizons; calm areas for text

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Title torn at the seam
sections.blueprint: A wrapper about 95svh tall per project holds a sticky stage of 100svh, split at exactly 50vw into two portrait panes of 720×900px, `object-fit: cover`, square corners, no gap: two different pictures or loops of the same project (the whole and a detail, before and after). The project's title sits on the seam, centred on x 720 at the optical middle: capitals in a heavy face at clamp(96px, 11vw, 160px), leading 0.8, tracking -0.04em, at most two lines, in one light colour chosen per project. It is set twice inside the one heading element, the second copy `aria-hidden`, each copy clipped to its own half with `clip-path: inset(0 50% 0 0)` and `inset(0 0 0 50%)`. Directly under it, centred, the discipline and year at 16px and a text link with an arrow at 16px. While a project crosses the stage, the left pane and left half-title travel up and the right pane and right half-title travel down (panes ±20svh, title ±30svh, on a scroll-linked timeline), so the name tears at the seam and lines up exactly when the project is centred. The section's two-word heading sits at clamp(28px, 2.4vw, 36px) in the stage's top-left corner, 32px in. Four to eight projects; the stage releases after the last. Under reduced motion the halves stay aligned and the projects change by crossfade.
sections.mobile: Keep the split: two strips 195px wide running the full height of the screen with the same opposing travel. The title drops to 12.5vw on the seam, at most two lines, with the discipline line and the link under it at 16px; give the link a 44px hit area.

sections.name: Title, note, facts row
sections.blueprint: First row: a heading of two to four words in a light weight at clamp(44px, 5vw, 76px) sits on the left margin in columns 1–6; a three-line paragraph at 16px, 260px wide, sits in columns 10–12 with its last line on the heading's baseline. Columns 7–9 stay empty. 120px lower, a second row sets three or four facts (a date, a time, a place, a price) as large light text at clamp(28px, 3vw, 44px), spread across the 12 columns with `justify-content: space-between`. Each fact has a one-line explanation at 14px directly under it in the soft ink, left-aligned to the fact. Facts are separated only by the space between them, so the row reads like the line of times on a printed programme. A photograph may start under the right half of the facts row, 5 columns wide at 4:3. Padding 140px top, 120px bottom.
sections.mobile: Heading at 11vw on the left margin; the note follows directly under it at 16px, full width. The facts become a two-column grid with a 32px row gap, each fact at 26px with its explanation beneath. Any photograph goes last, full width.

sections.name: One-size name columns
sections.blueprint: Pure text at one size. Three columns start on columns 1, 4 and 7 of the 12-column grid, leaving columns 10–12 empty on purpose. Each column opens with a group name in full ink and continues with a tight stack of six to ten capability names in the soft ink, all at 16–17px, regular weight, line-height 1.25, no bullets and no symbols; one blank line separates group name from stack. Hovering a name brings it to full ink and shows a one-line description in a fixed spot: the top of the empty columns 10–12, at the same size. The heading is no larger than 28px; two or three words, alone on column 1, 96px above the columns. Give the section 20vh of empty ground above and below, so the smallness reads as decided. Works on light or deep grounds.
sections.mobile: Columns stack with 40px between groups; text rises to 18px with line-height 1.4 for touch. Group names stay in full ink. Hover descriptions are dropped; each group ends instead with one sentence in the soft ink that sums it up. The heading is 24px, 48px above.

sections.name: Side facts, wide paragraph
sections.blueprint: Two rows share one vertical line at 34% of the viewport width. Row one: in a 160px column at the left margin, three label and value pairs stack with 20px between them, each a label in the soft ink with its value beneath in full ink, all at 13px (founded, based in, team size). From the 34% line a five-line paragraph at clamp(20px, 1.7vw, 26px), leading 1.35, runs to 90% of the width. Row two starts 120px lower and repeats the logic for the record of the practice: one plain word at 13px at the far left (awards, press, clients), then from the 34% line two list columns, each 260px wide with a 64px gutter, at 13px with 10px between lines: name at the left, year at the right in the soft ink. No heading; the paragraph opens the section. Each list comfortably holds 6–12 lines. No photographs are needed.
sections.mobile: Everything aligns to the left margin. The paragraph comes first at 19px. The three label and value pairs follow as a two-column grid at 14px. The two record lists stack with 40px between them, each opened by its plain word in full ink.

sections.name: One word is the button
sections.blueprint: The entire band is one link. A full-bleed field in the accent colour, about 60svh tall, contains a single verb of four to eight letters set at 24–30vw in the heaviest weight, tight tracking, sized with `clamp()` so it spans the content width on one line with its baseline 24px above the bottom edge. The `<a>` wraps the whole band; on hover and focus the field and the word swap colours instantly. In the top-left corner, at 20px, one sentence says what happens next; in the top-right, an arrow drawn as a simple inline SVG, 48px, points up and right. There is no other button anywhere in the section. In a page with a motif, the band's top corners take the motif's shape (a large radius, or a chamfer cut with `clip-path`). Keep the word honest: the action itself, not a slogan.
sections.mobile: The band is 46svh tall. The word is set at whatever size fills the width on one line; choose a shorter verb rather than going below 22vw. Sentence top-left at 17px across two lines, arrow top-right at 32px. The whole band stays tappable.

sections.name: Columns above, wordmark below
sections.blueprint: The footer inverts ground and ink and fills a whole viewport (min-height 100svh), arranged as three rows in a grid (auto 1fr auto). Top row, 40px from the edge: four small columns on the 12-column grid (address, navigation, social, hours or contact), each a plain list at 15–16px with its first line in the full ink and the rest in the softer ink. Middle row: empty. Bottom row: the wordmark alone, sized to run from the left margin to the right margin on one line. Set it as inline SVG text with a `viewBox` fitted to the word and `width: 100%`, or tune `font-size` in `vw` to the letter count, so it never wraps; its baseline sits 20px above a single line of legal text at 13px. With `position: sticky; bottom: 0` and a lower `z-index` than the page, the last section slides away to uncover it.
sections.mobile: Columns become two by two at 15px with 32px between rows, at the top. A gap of about 20svh follows. The wordmark spans the full width at the bottom; a name longer than ten letters stacks on two lines, each fitted to the width. Legal line beneath at 12px.

references.name: House of Honey
references.idea: A block-heavy wordmark pierced by a hairline script: the bold-against-delicate contrast is repeated at every scale, with giant pink script behind quiet serif statements.
references.hero: Top 42% is a flat blush-pink band; the bottom 58% is a full-bleed photograph of a bright living room, arched window on the centre axis, butting against the band with no margin. A tiny nav row sits at the very top with 8px side margins: block logo glyph and five links left, contact link with a small square arrow box far right. The wordmark fills the width edge to edge: two words in ultra-black extended caps, about 120px cap height, dark aubergine, with a hairline script 'of' 230px tall between them, overshooting above and below. Directly beneath, two two-line serif uppercase taglines at 31px, one flush left, one flush right.
references.type: Wordmark in ultra-black extended caps; statements in noeText serif, uppercase, 31–40px, tight tracking; nav and captions in neueHaasGrotesk around 14px; 'canora' hairline script for the connecting word and for cropped background words at 37vw. Three contrasting voices, each with one job.
references.colour: #edccbe #331917 #0e0e0e #f26fcb #ffffff — Blush pink and dark aubergine-brown alternate as full fields and as each other's text colour. Hot pink appears only in the oversized script and a 2px divider. Photographs bring saturated colour.
references.imagery: Editorial interior photography, saturated and daylight-lit. Hero is a full-bleed landscape crop; projects are portrait crops about 5:6 in a three-column grid with 4px gutters and square corners.
references.layout: Edge-to-edge with 8px outer margins. Typographic sections (small centred label, serif statement, cropped giant script) alternate with a three-column image grid. Blush and brown fields swap each section; hairline link rows close blocks. The footer is a full-width logo glyph.

sections.description: Dark aubergine field under the hero photo, separated by a 2px hot-pink line. A small sans label centred, then a three-line centred serif uppercase statement at about 31px in blush, 45% of the width. Behind it a hot-pink script phrase set near 37vw runs off both sides and is cut by the section's bottom edge, its ascenders rising into the statement. A smaller serif line follows.

Title card before the project grid. Blush field, nearly empty screen. A small label and a one-line serif uppercase heading about 40px sit centred at 55% height. The giant pink script returns, cropped by the bottom edge so only its top half shows and running off both sides.

Three columns edge to edge with 4px gutters and 8px outer margins. Portrait photos about 500×580px, square corners. Under each: an uppercase sans title at 14px and a grey line of GPS coordinates. Two rows, then a full-width hairline row with a text link left and a small square arrow box at the far right.

Brown field. The logo glyph is enlarged to full width and about a third of the screen: blush rectangles and quarter-circle arcs with 4px gaps, forming an abstract monogram. Below: four columns of small links, a hairline, two addresses in the first two columns, another hairline, then copyright left and a small blush button right.

steal: Set a wordmark edge to edge in ultra-heavy extended caps and thread a hairline script connecting word through it that overshoots the cap height both ways.
Use an oversized script word in one hot accent colour as a cropped background layer behind small, calm serif statements.
Split a tagline into two halves, flush left and flush right on the same baseline under the wordmark, instead of centring it.
references.media: The lower 58% of the fold is a full-bleed interior photograph that continues for one full viewport as a five-image crossfading slideshow with a pink progress line on its bottom edge. Below: a three-up grid of 4:5 project tiles with 8px gutters sliding over a giant script marquee, a full-bleed tinted feature photograph with its title docked bottom-left, a full-bleed photograph with an inset colour card, and one giant cropped letterform as the footer's picture, the photographs oversized to 110-170% of their frames for drift and no video anywhere.
references.motion: There is no visible preloader and the page is whole at 400ms; under Lenis, blocks rise 8px and fade in over 800ms ease-out at 0-260ms staggers (39 WAAPI calls), slideshow crossfades take 600ms cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.25,1), the oversized photographs drift, and script marquees run on CSS time (90-122s per pair). Page changes use a 1s view transition on the same curve; nothing pins, and there is one reduced-motion rule.

references.name: Nia Creative
references.idea: The three-letter wordmark becomes a slot-machine reel: the name repeats vertically and its middle letter is swapped for a square of client photography or video.
references.hero: Pale grey field with a slim nav: bracketed lowercase logo top-left, four uppercase mono links centred, a black pill button top-right. The centre 43% of the width holds a vertical reel of the wordmark stacked three times in very heavy black grotesk, each row about 230px tall; in every row the middle letter is replaced by a square photo or video tile (surfers, a woman holding glasses over her eyes, a burger). The middle row is sharp; rows above and below fade out through gradient masks. A bottom strip carries a mono descriptor at left and city plus live clock at right. A plum band starts at the fold.
references.type: A heavy, tightly tracked grotesk (xgnl) carries the wordmark, a 70px lowercase section word and bold 20 to 34px statements; body is the same face at 14px, bold. Geist Mono in small capitals handles nav, categories, bracketed indexes and the clock.
references.colour: #f3f3f3 #574d56 #515144 #1c1c1c #b9aebd #b3b586 — Pale grey base with black type. Two muted full-width bands, dusty plum and olive, set their text in a lighter tint of the band colour rather than white. Photography supplies the saturation.
references.imagery: Flash-lit hospitality and lifestyle photography plus short video: cocktails, hotel rooms, food, trail runners. Portrait tiles with one or two large rounded corners, square tiles inside the wordmark, and an edge-to-edge three-up strip.
references.layout: 28px side margins and a three-column grid for work. Big lowercase section words sit flush left with a small paragraph flush right. Sections alternate pale grey grids, coloured statement bands and full-bleed image strips; a black rounded nav bar pins to the top after the hero.

sections.description: Dusty plum band about one viewport tall. A bold 34px statement in pale lilac sits top-left across half the width, one phrase underlined with a hand-drawn stroke. Lower left, a small heading and eight industries in tiny uppercase mono split into two bulleted columns. At the right margin a tall portrait photo, about 20% of the width, with large rounded corners, overlaps the band's top edge and leaves the middle of the band empty.

A 70px heavy lowercase word flush left with a three-line 14px paragraph flush right on the same baseline. Below, three equal columns with wide gutters: each has a portrait image narrower than its column with a large radius on the bottom-right corner only, then a 20px project name, a mono uppercase category and a four-line bold description. Rows repeat with no dividers or card backgrounds.

Three photographs or clips butt together edge to edge with no gaps, each a third of the viewport wide and about 40% of a screen tall. Immediately below, an olive band: a three-line 26px statement in pale olive at left with one underlined phrase, two lines of small copy beneath it, and a small rounded portrait image tucked into the lower right corner.

Services as stacked sheets. Each is a full-width panel with a 1px outline and large top-corner radius that slides up over the previous one. The left half is empty except for a centred column: a bracketed mono index, a 26px bold title and four centred lines of sub-services. The right half is one photograph with rounded corners filling the panel height.

steal: Drop a photo tile into the wordmark in place of one letter and run the lockup as a vertical reel with masked top and bottom rows.
On coloured bands, set type in a lighter tint of the band's own hue instead of white to keep the band calm.
Round only one corner of each image tile, the same corner every time, as a quiet signature shape.

references.name: Depo Luxe
references.idea: A film production roster shown as a full-screen reel in which every step is one film with only a quoted italic title, a director and a client, set like credits at body size.
references.hero: Video fills the viewport edge to edge with no scrim beyond the footage's own darkness. All text is white serif at near-body size. A 305px-wide header block sits top-centre: the two words of the name pushed to its left and right edges, an italic one-line descriptor beneath, then five nav links spread across the same width with the current one underlined. Dead centre: the film title in italic with quotation marks at 40px (under 3% of viewport width), the director's name 60px below. The client name stands alone at the right edge on the title's line. A roman numeral above a thin vertical line marks the left edge.
references.type: EB Garamond only, regular and italic, always white. The largest text on the page is the 40px italic title; names and nav are about 17px. Two sizes, no capitals, no bold, slight negative tracking; the wordmark is simply two words set far apart.
references.colour: #070c0b #081514 #16120d #1f3fd6 #f0f0f0 — Black ground; all colour comes from the footage: teal-black interiors, blue-tinted lenses, one saturated cobalt frame. Type stays white throughout, with no accent colour or UI tint.
references.imagery: Full-bleed commercial film footage: tight faces, extreme close-ups, underwater shots, heavy cinema grade and grain. One per screen, never framed or rounded, with text laid directly on top.
references.layout: One screen equals one project: no margins, cards or grid. Three fixed text anchors repeat on every screen (centre title, right-edge client, left-edge numeral) so only the footage changes. The page is a single viewport that swaps its contents.

sections.description: Each project is a full-viewport slide that keeps the hero's three anchors: quoted italic title dead centre with the director beneath, client name hard against the right edge at the same height, and a roman numeral on the left edge that moves down a thin vertical track as you advance, doubling as progress indicator. Between slides the frame goes fully black with the next title already in place before its footage fades in.

The header is a compact credit block rather than a bar: a fixed column about a fifth of the viewport wide, centred at the top, holding three justified lines (name split to both ends, italic descriptor, five links). It has no background and stays over the footage on every slide. On mobile the same block widens to the text column and the client name moves above the title.

steal: Keep every piece of text at body size over full-bleed footage and let position alone (dead centre, right edge, left edge) create the hierarchy.
Build the header as a narrow centred block of three justified lines, with the two-word name pushed to opposite ends of the first line.
Use a roman numeral sliding along a thin vertical edge line as both project index and scroll progress.
